 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN KUMAR JHA  ORAL ORDER 2 21-07-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP for the State.
2.

In the present case, the petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Bihar P.S.
Case No. 177 of 2016, registered for the alleged offences under Sections 409 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code.
3.

As per prosecution case, the petitioners and other co-accused persons were entrusted with the task of replenishing the cash in different ATMs by their company namely, RCI Cash Management Service Pvt. Ltd.

entities.text: RCI Cash Management Service Pvt. Ltd.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
While the petitioners and other co-accused persons were working as custodians for replenishing of cash in ATMs, a shortage of Rs.2.57 crores used in 24 ATMs Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.33564 of 2023(2) dt.21-07-2023 has been discovered.
The informant showed his suspicion that the petitioner and other co-accused persons manipulated the switch counters of ATMs to show that there was no shortage.
It is further alleged that the petitioners and other co-accused persons promised to deposit the shortage amount, but, thereafter, they absconded.
4. The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are innocent and have been falsely implicated in this case merely on suspicion.

The learned counsel further submits that the Samar Raj vs The State Of Bihar on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16148368/

sentences.text: petitioners
were given responsibility to collect the cash from the bank and they were required to hand over the same to the Area Manager and the Regional Manager of their company, who

,
thereafter, took decision about the amount which was to be deposited in the ATMs.
The petitioners fully deposited the amount in different ATMs and balance amount was again deposited in the account of the company or the Area Manager or the Regional Manager.
Thus, the petitioners are not responsible for any shortage.
5. Learned APP opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail submitting that there is specific allegation against the petitioners for misappropriation and criminal breach of trust.

The learned APP further submits that the petitioners did not Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.33564 of 2023(2)
dt.21-07-2023 fully replenish the cash in different ATMs and also manipulated the switch counters of ATMs to hide their conduct.

6. Having regard to the facts and circumstances and submissions made on behalf of the parties and considering the grave nature of accusation against the petitioners, I do not think it is a fit case for grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioners.
7. Accordingly, their prayer for anticipatory bail is rejected.

(Arun Kumar Jha, J) V.K.Pandey/-
